direction.camera: Guide attention with clinical clarity; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: present one verified measurement in a spacious clinical frame; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with white field; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with soft blue.
direction.lighting: shadowless studio wash; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: sterile polymer and clear glass; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around trustworthy scale; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use clinical clarity,white field,calm data,hygienic geometry,trustworthy scale,soft blue as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
